action.title: Action
action.description: funding_leads = newest Form D filings (companies that just raised = sales leads); insider_transactions = Form 4 director/officer buys and sells; snapshot = company profile + financials + recent filings; filing_search = full-text search across filings.

symbol.title: Ticker or CIK (snapshot / insider)
symbol.description: e.g. NVDA, AAPL, TSLA, or a 10-digit CIK

forms.title: Filing forms (filing_search)
forms.description: Comma-separated form types, e.g. 10-K or 10-K,8-K or 8-K

days_back.title: Days back
days_back.description: How many days back to search (filings / funding window).

limit.title: Max results
limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

industries.title: Sector filter (funding_leads)
industries.description: Optional comma-separated Form D sectors to keep, e.g. 'Other Technology' or 'Health Care,Other Technology'. Leave blank for all operating companies.

exclude_funds.title: Exclude investment funds (funding_leads)
exclude_funds.description: Drop pooled investment funds / SPVs from results (recommended for B2B leads).

exclude_real_estate.title: Exclude property SPVs (funding_leads)
exclude_real_estate.description: Drop real-estate / property-owning LLCs that are not operating companies.
